notes: Stories refined for clearer separation of persistence vs evaluation and tighter alignment with manifest + snapshot tooling.

change_log.value: Explicitly defines persistence contract with brain_snapshot and manifest_generator outputs including storage location and retrieval contract.
Clarifies dual-check logic: TTL expiry and SHA-256 drift against current filesystem using manifest_generator hashing behavior.
Clarifies enforcement behavior: block or trigger existing manifest regeneration step without introducing new pipeline steps.
change_log.note: Ensure no scope expansion per governance

stories.title: Define Manifest Snapshot Freshness Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define schema for manifest snapshot metadata including generated_at timestamp, source SHA-256 hash, file count, and TTL policy; specify persistence and retrieval contract aligned with manifest_generator output and brain_snapshot storage.

stories.title: Implement Manifest Freshness Evaluation Engine
stories.description: Implement logic to compute freshness using TTL expiry, generated_at age, and SHA-256 comparison between current file system state and last manifest snapshot, leveraging manifest_generator hashing behavior.

stories.title: Expose Manifest Freshness Status via Internal Service API
stories.description: Provide internal callable service/API returning freshness status (fresh, stale, regenerate_required) with metadata (age_seconds, ttl, hash_match, last_generated_at) for use by pipelines.

stories.title: Integrate Freshness Enforcement into Dev Pipeline and Brain Runner
stories.description: Integrate freshness checks into dev_pipeline and brain_runner to block execution or trigger existing manifest regeneration when status is stale or regenerate_required, without introducing new pipeline steps.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Manifest Freshness and Enforcement
stories.description: Create tests validating schema correctness, TTL expiration behavior, hash mismatch detection, and enforcement behavior within dev_pipeline and brain_runner execution paths.
